portal_description:
The Pacemaker cluster resource manager is a collection of technologies working together to maintain data integrity and application availability in the event of failures.

Enhancement(s):

* The "multiple-active" resource meta-attribute now accepts "stop_unexpected" as a value, to stop only the unexpected instances of a multiply active resource (BZ#2062850)

IMPORTANT: The new feature should not be configured until all nodes in the
cluster are running a pacemaker version that supports it. Users who do not
intend to use the new feature do not need to apply the update.
